using CUDA
using JSON3

function probe()
    d = CuArray([1.0, 2.0, 3.0])
    x = -1.0
    y = -1.0
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
        x = d[1] + 10.0      # scalar assignment INSIDE the block
        y = x * 2.0
    end
    return (x, y)
end

function main()
    if !CUDA.functional(); println(JSON3.write(Dict("error"=>"no CUDA"))); exit(1); end
    x, y = probe()
    println(JSON3.write(Dict(
        "x_after_block" => x, "y_after_block" => y,
        "assignments_survive" => (x == 11.0 && y == 22.0),
        "cuda_version" => string(CUDA.runtime_version()),
        "device" => CUDA.name(CUDA.device()))))
end
main()
